name: Juya Tripathy / ଜୁୟା ତ୍ରିପାଠୀ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Juya Tripathy’s Odia poem ‘ପ୍ରେମ’ appears in Kabita Live’s July 2026 edition. It answers the idea that love belongs only to youth or bodily desire by imagining a beloved’s arrival at the very end of life.

The speaker waits beyond fading sight and physical strength for a touch and a kiss on a wrinkled forehead. With the images of Ganga water and a final embrace, the poem brings tenderness into conversation with mortality and spiritual release.
